mechanism: Meloxicam (NSAID) may reduce the efficacy of propylthiouracil through inhibition of prostaglandin-mediated immune regulation, while NSAIDs increase risk of agranulocytosis when combined with myelosuppressive agents like PTU.
action: Monitor complete blood counts regularly; consider alternative antithyroid agent or non-NSAID analgesic; if combination necessary, use lowest effective NSAID dose for shortest duration.
